description: Why is it so hard to find an affordable home to buy? Multiple Kitsap and Mason County residents have written to me about the number of short-term rentals next door that are not owner occupied. This is known as STR IIs. I have heard this same story again and again. Across much of these counties, there are now more homes listed as short-term rentals than homes for sale.
